 a loyal butler, and a loving family.
Life seemed perfect—until one day I learned the truth.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/ee9612260d15048ce1920ca6d19e1f8f110b85d7.png[/img]


The mansion belonged to a family of villains.
My “father” was a ruthless warmonger, 
and my real mother a war widow from an invaded land.
Worse, my father was planning to attack my hometown.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/89fee2c755c9fa60354d15088147bb21cf8d6ebd.png[/img]


To stop him and reunite with my mother, I tried to escape.
But the women of the mansion suddenly turned against me, 
using every trick to tempt and stop me.

notes.title: A monochrome love begins❤️《Life in The Janitor's Room with A JK Girl》is out now🔥
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/5bb3cfff3a0cea823e07d494e3318a2d9750b7a5.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606830


“Hey, mister! I’m here again!”
The janitor’s dull routine changed the day her voice filled the room.
His once colorless life... might just be heading into spring.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/672256c1855488d93ca1c7c0356f93dcd45611a3.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/ae248b1d1d0614b3dc54f168cdb3d442415f5969.jpg[/img]

One day, gyaru schoolgirl Futaba Arisa barges into the janitor’s room
—and falls in love with the place.
Now she skips class just to hang out.
What should the older janitor do?

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/b2654c1c0b900f4074e338393cf2d905b52300ac.jpg[/img]

Simple: win her heart!
Talk, learn her story—and maybe pull a prank while she naps.
Raise her affection and unlock date events!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/19c0c9ae756ef6bfcc07230f34718debd8f5669e.jpg[/img]

With 50,000 words of emotional writing and a monochrome art style,
this game is for those who want to care for a lonely girl
—or fall in love with the beauty of a colorless world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606830

[h1]✤Story✤[/h1]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/ad13a0abd409003276bddb01dbcbb2eec3ff19bf.png[/img]
The female warrior Rebecca is the strongest warrior in this small border village.
Rebecca is not only powerful with swordsmanship but also very kind-hearted. 
She plays a role similar to the village guardian and is deeply trusted by the villagers.
One day, Rebecca's village was attacked by a group of bandits. 
Almost all the villagers were kidnapped, including Takezo, the person of her unrequited love.
So Rebecca embarked on a journey, vowing to defeat the bandits and save the villagers.
In a new continent, Rebecca obtained the magic sword "Cursed Sword". 
And this magic sword will greatly change her destiny...!? 
When the bandits are defeated and Rebecca successfully takes back her sweetheart, what will happen to the strongest female warrior in the village?

[h1]✤Game Content✤[/h1]
